visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hand holds a green smartphone in the foreground. The phone screen displays a video of a man with light-colored hair wearing a leopard-print jacket, standing in a green outdoor park setting with trees and daylight. He is speaking directly to the camera with expressive facial movements. (2) The camera transitions to a real-life office setting. A man in a bright orange long-sleeved shirt and a grey baseball cap stands in the middle of the room, which has white desks and office equipment. He performs a rhythmic dance, giving a thumbs-up and making heart shapes with his hands. Colorful animated hearts and sparkles are overlaid on the screen around him. (3) The man in orange continues his dance as he moves behind another man who is sitting at a desk in a blue sweatshirt. The background is a cluttered office with multiple computer monitors, papers, and shelves. The dancing man makes more hand gestures while leaning over the seated man. (4) The camera focuses in a medium close-up shot on the seated man's face. He has dark hair, wears an earring, and smiles slightly while looking down at the papers on his desk. The man in orange remains visible in the background, maintaining his energetic dancing posture. (5) The shot changes to an extreme close-up of the man in orange, who smiles broadly and makes a cute expression towards the camera. Suddenly, the seated man in the blue shirt brings a large white paper into the frame and slaps the man in orange across the face with it, causing his face to tilt.
